# HealingMart font policy
Mandatory: read AGENTS.md and [global license policy](https://github.com/healingmart/healingmart-cloudflare-guide-test/blob/policy/pretendard-20261028/FONT_POLICY.md). Self-host Pretendard Variable (OFL) by default, licensed Noto Sans for other languages. No paid/unknown/OS-proprietary fonts; require a checked font gate before deploy. No automatic production deployments.
